understood.text:
feat(decisions): backport the decisions and Jev follow-ups to stable/1.104.x and bump to 1.104.3

## TLDR

Backports the decisions and Jev work merged on main since #45190 onto stable/1.104.x, without the decisions playground, so the 1.104.3 patch serves every decisions provider and SDK shape the launch ships with

Problem this solves:

- stable/1.104.x only has the openai, perplexity, typesafe, openrouter, cloudflare and strands_decider decisions providers
- It has no hosted_vllm or azure_ai Microsoft-Decision-1 provider, no AgentCore runtime ARN support, no `litellm.systemone`
- OpenRouter decisions calls are billed from the cost map instead of the provider-reported `usage.cost`
- TypeSafe and Strands Decider are missing from the Add Model provider list, and Swagger UI does not describe the two decisions routes

How it solves it:

- Bumps the line to 1.104.3 in its own commit
- Cherry-picks the 16 main commits listed under Picks with `git cherry-pick -x`, adapted where stable/1.104.x lacks what they build on
- Regenerates `schema.d.ts` on the line instead of merging the generated file by hand
- Leaves the decisions playground (#45654, #45732, #45755) out, as asked

## User Flow

Before: a proxy admin on 1.104.2 cannot route a decisions request to a hosted vLLM or Azure decider

1. They add `hosted_vllm/my-decider` or `azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1` to the config and start the proxy
2. They send POST http://localhost:4000/v1/decisions with that model, an input and yes/no questions
3. They get HTTP 400 "Unknown Decisions provider", and the Add Model page has no TypeSafe or Strands Decider provider

After: the same request is answered, and the new providers show up everywhere the old ones did

1. They add the same models to the config and start the proxy
2. The same POST http://localhost:4000/v1/decisions returns HTTP 200 with one answer per question and a `usage` block, billed at the line's price for that model
3. http://localhost:4000/ui/?page=models lists TypeSafe and Strands Decider under Add Model, and http://localhost:4000/#/v1/decisions in Swagger UI documents both routes
4. `litellm.systemone(...)` and `litellm.decisions(...)` work from the SDK with the same shapes as main

## Picks

- [x] 79f62db620 feat(decisions): add the OpenAI Decisions spec types and the System One translation (#45129)
- [x] 0e09e99146 refactor(decisions): dispatch /v1/decisions through provider configs and the shared HTTP handler (#45130)
- [x] a7b04a8028 test(decisions): post System One bodies to /v1/systemone in the translation bases (#45327)
- [x] 6e54dced8c test: realign stale decisions and lens tests with merged behaviour (#45346)
- [x] 3a3b8cad80 feat(ui): add TypeSafe and Strands Decider to the Add Model provider list (#45335)
- [x] 0e48048bd5 chore(decisions): remove the System One converters and OpenAI spec types left dead by #45214 (#45442)
- [x] 61e5f2dd3c feat(decisions): add hosted_vllm provider (#45501)
- [x] de6a0717b7 feat(azure): add azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1 (#45639)
- [x] 465f20f274 fix(openrouter): bill responses, decisions and pass-through from usage.cost and always allow reasoning params (#45640), decisions and pass-through billing only
- [x] 2fcc780498 feat(azure_ai): support Microsoft-Decision-1 on the decisions API (#45673)
- [x] 546402c98c fix(decisions)!: refuse safety_identifier on providers that cannot take it unless drop_params drops it (#44955)
- [x] 674208bb7d fix(model_prices): drop unverified output price for azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1 (#45717)
- [x] ed9c31cfa8 feat(strands_decider): call a Strands Decider on an AgentCore runtime ARN (#45678)
- [x] bc2cc42340 docs(proxy): describe /v1/decisions and /v1/systemone in Swagger UI (#45838)
- [x] 5894968c5d test(decisions): bill the OpenAI-format openrouter case from provider-reported cost (#45853)
- [x] 25d9b05386 feat(sdk): add litellm.systemone and trim litellm.decisions to the OpenAI shape (#45846)

Skipped on purpose

- #45654, #45732, #45755: the decisions playground and its Add Model sublabel, excluded on this line
- #45200: Databricks `ai_decide` and the auto-router decider need the Laya and Bespoke classifier work (#43626, #44246, #44928) that is not on the line
- #45661: hosted_vllm translation cases need the newer `tests/integration/translation` runner

Adaptations on this line

- The shared HTTP handler keeps the line's `_get_httpx_client` name and its `DecisionsIRRequest` flow, with the AgentCore signing from #45678 on top
- The OpenRouter Responses API half of #45640 is left out because it imports `litellm_core_utils.hidden_params`, which the line does not have; the decisions and pass-through billing from `usage.cost` is in
- The Databricks tests that #45846 added to `tests/unit/decisions/test_main.py` are dropped with #45200
- `tests/unit/conftest.py` gets the per-test logging worker flush from main (#44146), without which the new systemone callback test sees callbacks queued by earlier tests
- `ui/litellm-dashboard/src/lib/http/schema.d.ts` is regenerated with `npm run gen:api`, and the Strands logo is copied from main
- The lazy-route and Sail tests that only exist on rc/1.105.0 and main are left out of the picked test files, and `tests/integration/management/test_model_health_check.py` is not on this line so its hunk is dropped
- The picks come from the rc/1.105.0 backport branch, so every commit body still names its main commit, and the line gets its own `bump: version 1.104.3` commit

## Testing

- `tests/unit/decisions`, `tests/unit/systemone`, `tests/unit/proxy/decisions_endpoints`, `tests/unit/proxy/public_endpoints`, the strands_decider, openrouter, azure_ai and hosted_vllm provider tests, `tests/test_litellm/proxy/auth/test_auth_utils.py`, `tests/test_litellm/proxy/common_utils/test_custom_openapi_spec.py` and `tests/unit/test_cost_map_guard.py`: 1131 passed on this branch
- `provider_info_helpers.test.tsx`: 75 passed, no type errors
- ruff reports no new findings on the touched Python files against stable/1.104.x
- The live before and after on a proxy built from this branch is the /ready follow-along video, linked from the Slack READY ping

## Screenshots / Proof of Fix

Live /qa leg at this tip (fd7aec367b) against the merge base (19180f34a2, 1.104.2): two proxies booted from clean worktrees with `--num_workers 2`, their own Postgres and Redis, real TypeSafe, OpenRouter and Azure AI Foundry keys from the shared vault, real spend. Full command and output log in the QA record kept with the run; the flips a user sees:

```
# [C1] POST /v1/decisions model=typesafe/jev-1.13.0 with safety_identifier
BEFORE: HTTP 200 (param silently dropped)   x-litellm-response-cost: 1.1886e-05
AFTER:  HTTP 400 litellm.UnsupportedParamsError: typesafe does not support parameters: ['safety_identifier'] ...
# [C2] same body on a deployment with drop_params: true
BEFORE: HTTP 200   AFTER: HTTP 200

# [D] POST /v1/decisions model=openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.13 (billing from usage.cost)
BEFORE: HTTP 200 (no x-litellm-response-cost header, spend log 0)
AFTER:  HTTP 200 x-litellm-response-cost: 1.239e-05

# [G1] POST /v1/systemone model=azure_ai/decision-1 (real Microsoft-Decision-1 deployment)
BEFORE: HTTP 400 Unknown Decisions provider 'azure_ai'. Supported providers: perplexity, typesafe, openrouter, cloudflare, strands_decider, openai
AFTER:  HTTP 200 {"model":"microsoft-decision-1","answers":{...}}
# [G2] same on POST /v1/decisions: BEFORE 400, AFTER 200

# [F] GET /v1/model/info azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1
BEFORE: input_cost_per_token null, mode null
AFTER:  input_cost_per_token 4.2e-08, output_cost_per_token 0.0, mode evaluation

# [L] GET /openapi.json, POST /v1/decisions
BEFORE: summary "Decisions", no description, no request example
AFTER:  summary "Ask questions about an input (OpenAI Decisions format)", description, example, schema props input/model/questions/safety_identifier

# Admin UI Add Model provider dropdown (Playwright, before :49819 / after :48789 via GET /public/providers/fields)
BEFORE: no TypeSafe or Strands Decider entries (GET /public/providers/fields: 0 matches)
AFTER:  "TypeSafe" and "Strands Decider" entries present with their default model placeholders
```

Two picks could not be exercised live and are blocked, not mocked: hosted_vllm (no vLLM server; the route now resolves the provider and fails on connect instead of 400 unknown provider) and the Strands Decider AgentCore call (no AgentCore runtime ARN credential in the shared vault)

## Pre-Submission checklist

**Please complete all items before asking a LiteLLM maintainer to review your PR**

- [x] I have added meaningful tests
- [x] The handful of test files covering my change pass locally, e.g. `uv run pytest tests/unit/<your_test_file>.py -v`. Leave the suites (`make test-unit-*`, `make test-unit`) to CI: it finishes in ~15 minutes where a laptop takes an hour or more
- [ ] My PR passes all required CI/CD checks (e.g., lint, schema.d.ts sync check, etc.)
- [x] My PR's scope is as isolated as possible; it only solves 1 specific problem
- [ ] I have received a Greptile **Confidence Score of at least 4/5** before requesting a maintainer review (Greptile reviews automatically once the PR is opened; only comment `@greptileai` to re-request a review after pushing changes)

## Type

🆕 New Feature

## Caveats (if any)

### Medium

- No Databricks decisions provider on this line, so `databricks/...` decisions requests still return the unknown provider 400
- The OpenRouter Responses API still bills from the cost map on this line, only decisions and pass-through use `usage.cost`

### Low

- #44955 is a behavior change: a non-string `safety_identifier` on a provider that cannot take it is now a 400 unless `drop_params` drops it

## Final Attestation

- [x] The tests check the right things, including the edge cases, and regressions in the respective real-world customer use-cases are not possible after this PR

feat(decisions): backport the decisions and Jev follow-ups to stable/1.104.x and bump to 1.104.3

## TLDR

Backports the decisions and Jev work merged on main since #45190 onto stable/1.104.x, without the decisions playground, so the 1.104.3 patch serves every decisions provider and SDK shape the launch ships with

Problem this solves:

- stable/1.104.x only has the openai, perplexity, typesafe, openrouter, cloudflare and strands_decider decisions providers
- It has no hosted_vllm or azure_ai Microsoft-Decision-1 provider, no AgentCore runtime ARN support, no `litellm.systemone`
- OpenRouter decisions calls are billed from the cost map instead of the provider-reported `usage.cost`
- TypeSafe and Strands Decider are missing from the Add Model provider list, and Swagger UI does not describe the two decisions routes

How it solves it:

- Bumps the line to 1.104.3 in its own commit
- Cherry-picks the 16 main commits listed under Picks with `git cherry-pick -x`, adapted where stable/1.104.x lacks what they build on
- Regenerates `schema.d.ts` on the line instead of merging the generated file by hand
- Leaves the decisions playground (#45654, #45732, #45755) out, as asked

## User Flow

Before: a proxy admin on 1.104.2 cannot route a decisions request to a hosted vLLM or Azure decider

1. They add `hosted_vllm/my-decider` or `azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1` to the config and start the proxy
2. They send POST http://localhost:4000/v1/decisions with that model, an input and yes/no questions
3. They get HTTP 400 "Unknown Decisions provider", and the Add Model page has no TypeSafe or Strands Decider provider

After: the same request is answered, and the new providers show up everywhere the old ones did

1. They add the same models to the config and start the proxy
2. The same POST http://localhost:4000/v1/decisions returns HTTP 200 with one answer per question and a `usage` block, billed at the line's price for that model
3. http://localhost:4000/ui/?page=models lists TypeSafe and Strands Decider under Add Model, and http://localhost:4000/#/v1/decisions in Swagger UI documents both routes
4. `litellm.systemone(...)` and `litellm.decisions(...)` work from the SDK with the same shapes as main

## Picks

- [x] 79f62db620 feat(decisions): add the OpenAI Decisions spec types and the System One translation (#45129)
- [x] 0e09e99146 refactor(decisions): dispatch /v1/decisions through provider configs and the shared HTTP handler (#45130)
- [x] a7b04a8028 test(decisions): pos
